_doc: Synthetic 2-task CO-Bench-shaped fixture for the builtin-parity Checkpoint A test (plan §12.1). Each task drives the BuiltinBackend through a fake native solver returning the given solution + outer-token usage; the scorer returns the given score/raw_score. This is install-free: no real CO-Bench data, no Docker, no subprocess.
